tutorial.name: Create a Holoscan Module
tutorial.description: End-to-end walkthrough for scaffolding, building, testing, packaging, and publishing a new Holoscan Module. Covers external (standalone) modules as the primary path and HoloHub-hosted descriptor modules as a secondary path.

changelog.0.3.1: Verify CLI 5.0.0 workflows and clarify image prerequisites, Python build paths, and native CTest behavior
changelog.0.3.0: Add the optional Python bindings workflow for SDK 5.0 Modules
changelog.0.2.0: Update the standalone Module workflow for the Holoscan SDK 5.0 C++ API and Debian packaging
